name: Oketra
description: Oketra is the cat-headed archer god of solidarity on Amonkhet, a sibling of the other gods and the mother of Ketramose, who called Gideon her Champion.

description_citations.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.
"Aetherdrift | Hour of Restoration" by Hadeer Elsbai. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

summary.text: Oketra is the cat-headed archer god of solidarity on Amonkhet, a sibling of the other gods and the mother of Ketramose, who called Gideon her Champion.

citations.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.
"Aetherdrift | Hour of Restoration" by Hadeer Elsbai. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

bio.text: Oketra met Gideon, named him Kytheon Iora, and brought him toward the Trials, calling him her Champion.

citations.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

bio.text: When the dragon came, her arrows failed to harm him, and she and Hazoret fled to a mausoleum to gather orphaned children before the dragon blanked their minds.

citations.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.
"The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.
"The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

bio.text: She rallied the stunned gods and, as the locusts ate the Hekma, recalled the prophecy and declared the Hour of Promise had begun.

citations.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.
"Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

bio.text: She fought the scorpion god with Kefnet, blasting its head to dust with an arrow, but it reconstituted and impaled her with its stinger as she leaped between it and Tuya.

citations.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.
"The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.
"The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

bio.text: Kawit took one of her arrows as a spear after her death, and Basri later took up one of her arrows to champion her ideals.

citations.text: "Hour of Eternity" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jul 2017.
"Basri Ket". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: As a God-Eternal she shot Gideon's pegasus at Ravnica and was destroyed.

citations.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.
"War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

status.text: Oketra is dead, having been killed by the scorpion god and later destroyed as a God-Eternal, and her son Ketramose appears holding her bow in the latest story.

citations.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.
"War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.
"Aetherdrift | Hour of Restoration" by Hadeer Elsbai. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Gideon meets the god Oketra, who names him Kytheon Iora and says the others' fates are undecided.
timeline.quote: "You're one of mine, Kytheon Iora," she said.

citation.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Temmet lodges them in two rooms; Gideon watches Oketra walk to her temple.
timeline.quote: Liliana swept into one of the rooms and closed the door without a word.

citation.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Unable to sleep, Gideon seeks out Oketra at dawn, telling her he seeks her.
timeline.quote: "You," he said.

citation.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Oketra appears, forbids approaching the sarcophagi, and Nissa tells her telepathically that her world is dying; Oketra shows fear and has no memory of before.
timeline.quote: " These sarcophagi are forbidden to approach ," Oketra said out loud.

citation.text: "The Writing on the Wall" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon reveals he is competing in the Trials as Oketra's Champion despite Chandra's objections.
timeline.quote: "These gods are good at their core. I want to prove myself to them."

citation.text: "The Writing on the Wall" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Oketra urges initiates to stand with their crop and become the storm.
timeline.quote: Stand with your crop. Become the storm.

citation.text: In Oketra's Name (Amonkhet, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Basri completes Oketra's Trial of Solidarity, shielding his crop with sand; his spark ignites and he is carried to another plane.
timeline.quote: Basri's latent Planeswalker's spark ignited and he found himself on another plane

citation.text: "Basri Ket", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Basri returns to Amonkhet to find it a smoking ruin and Oketra dead.
timeline.quote: Oketra was dead, and everything he had believed turned out to be an elaborate lie.

citation.text: "Basri Ket", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Amonkhet Oketra recognizes Gideon as Kytheon Iora and he pledges himself to her to face the trials.
timeline.quote: pledging himself to her to face the Trials of the Five Gods

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oketra's Trial of Solidarity: a crop must defend its obelisk and retrieve her arrow together.
timeline.quote: The crop had to work together to defend their obelisk and retrieve Oketra's arrow.

citation.text: "God Trials", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oketra patrols Naktamun, shooting dangers seen through the Hekma and leading initiates through the first Trial.
timeline.quote: She patrolled the city's streets, firing golden arrows at any dangers she saw

citation.text: "Oketra", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Initiates perform the Ascent at the wheat harvest, climbing the exterior stairs with burdens to present offerings to Oketra.
timeline.quote: Each year, Oketra is honored through an ancient rite known as the Ascent , performed at the wheat harvest.

citation.text: "Oketra's Monument", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Trial of Solidarity, Oketra looses a radiant arrow into the floor, the arena shifts, and waves of foes attack the initiates and their obelisk.
timeline.quote: Oketra appears on a balcony, drawing an arrow of radiant light from the orb crowning the pyramid.

citation.text: "Oketra's Monument", section "Trial of Solidarity". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Initiates must split their efforts between retrieving the arrow and defending the obelisk to prove themselves worthy.
timeline.quote: Should the obelisk fall, the trial fails

citation.text: "Oketra's Monument", section "Trial of Solidarity". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Samut, Djeru and Hapatra witness the deaths of Rhonas, Kefnet and Oketra.
timeline.quote: Together with Hapatra , they witnessed the death of Rhonas , Kefnet , and Oketra .

citation.text: "Samut", section "Convincing Djeru". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Temmet first meets the Gatewatch after they pass through the Hekma, leads them through Naktamun and takes them before Oketra.
timeline.quote: he agreed to lead them through the city and answered questions about their way of life

citation.text: "Temmet", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon follows Oketra through Naktamun and watches her warm, kind interactions with the people.
timeline.quote: There was no groveling, no fear from the masses before an almighty presence.

citation.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon, wearing a cartouche Oketra gave him, comes to a celebration square where initiates feast before the Trial of Ambition.
timeline.quote: I noticed all these initiates had cartouches with three segments.

citation.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Oketra tells Gideon this is where the Trials begin, then leaves him with the initiate Djeru, who greets him as a friend.
timeline.quote: I am Djeru of the Tah crop.

citation.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

timeline.summary: The gods of Amonkhet fight the dragon outside the Hekma, and Oketra's arrows fail to harm him.
timeline.quote: The arrow hit the dragon's side, and he laughed.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret and Oketra flee to a mausoleum and gather the orphaned children as the dragon follows.
timeline.quote: Hazoret began gently picking up as many children as she could.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The dragon breaks the seal and blanks the minds of Hazoret and Oketra, who fall defeated.
timeline.quote: the minds of the two gods went utterly blank.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: All five gods gather at the bloody Luxa, but the God-Pharaoh does not arrive.
timeline.quote: The five stood before the crimson shores of the Luxa

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Oketra rallies the stunned gods, and Hazoret is disturbed that Rhonas blasphemed the God-Pharaoh.
timeline.quote: doubt nibbled at the edges of her heart

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The locust god releases a swarm that begins eating the Hekma, and Oketra recalls the prophecy and declares the Hour of Promise has begun.
timeline.quote: a swarm of locusts poured forth from its hands.

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The scorpion god tears the serpent in two and advances while the other two gods enter Naktamun.
timeline.quote: the other two gods crossed the threshold of the gate into the city of Naktamun.

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Hapatra finds Kefnet and Oketra confronting the scorpion god, and Oketra tells her the gods are there to protect the mortals.
timeline.quote: We are here to protect you

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Kefnet and Oketra fight the scorpion god in tandem, and it grazes Kefnet's wing.
timeline.quote: They moved in tandem with one another

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Oketra's arrow of white light blasts through the scorpion god's head and it crumbles to dust.
timeline.quote: The scorpion god's pursuit was halted by Oketra's arrow of white light exploding through his head.

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Oketra leaps between Tuya and the scorpion god and is impaled by its stinger while Gideon cries out.
timeline.quote: the scorpion god's stinger was lodged in Oketra's gut.

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Kawit, enraged at Oketra's death, takes one of her arrows as a spear and destroys a minotaur Eternal.
timeline.quote: There was a flash of white light as the minotaur disintegrated

citation.text: "Hour of Eternity" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Kawit hurls Oketra's spear at the dragon, but he freezes it and it snaps; he calls her useful only in a different world and walks away.
timeline.quote: you might have been useful.

citation.text: "Hour of Eternity" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Oketra gave everything for others to the end.
timeline.quote: To the end, all Oketra did was for others.

citation.text: Oketra's Last Mercy (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Oketra dies facing the Scorpion God as Gideon witnesses; Kefnet falls too.
timeline.quote: When Oketra and Kefnet fell, the two surviving gods turned on each other

citation.text: "Final Hours", section "The Hour of Promise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oketra is killed by the Scorpion God in the Hour of Promise after healing people of Naktamun.
timeline.quote: Oketra was killed by the Scorpion God

citation.text: "Oketra", section "Hour of Devastation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As Oketra is slain, mummies begin to embalm her corpse; she later returns as part of the Dreadhorde in War of the Spark.
timeline.quote: As Oketra was slain, mummies began to embalm her corpse.

citation.text: "Zombie", section "Eternals". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oketra's shot pierces Gideon's pegasus and Gideon tumbles through the air with the Blackblade.
timeline.quote: Gideon tumbled through the air, Blackblade in hand.

citation.text: Divine Arrow (War of the Spark, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Liliana whispers to Oketra and Bontu's remaining consciousness to turn on Bolas.
timeline.quote: "You are the gods. He is the usurper. You know what to do."

citation.text: Despark (War of the Spark, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Liliana seizes control of Bontu and Oketra and orders them to attack Bolas.
timeline.quote: she seized control of Bontu and Oketra

citation.text: "Bontu", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas repels Oketra and Bontu, obliterates Oketra, and sends Niv-Mizzet flying with a wing strike.
timeline.quote: later obliterate Oketra, with merely a thought

citation.text: "Elderspell", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon strikes Bolas with the Blackblade, but it breaks against the dragon's flesh.
timeline.quote: He struck Bolas in the head with Blackblade, but the sword broke against the dragon's flesh

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana, controlling Oketra, deliberately misses Gideon.
timeline.quote: Liliana directly controlled Oketra in shooting down Gideon

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet impales Bolas and Bontu extracts all his sparks.
timeline.quote: Bontu was able to bite the Dragon-God and extract all of Bolas's collected sparks, including his own.

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bontu bites Bolas and harvests all his sparks, leaving him desparked.
timeline.quote: the distraction allowed Bontu to bite Bolas and harvest all of the elder dragon's sparks, including Bolas's own

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet impales Bolas through the back with Hazoret's spear while Bolas is under attack; Bontu then extracts all of Bolas's sparks.
timeline.quote: Niv-Mizzet surprised Nicol Bolas by impaling the elder dragon through the back with Hazoret's spear.

citation.text: "Niv-Mizzet", section "The New Living Guildpact". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oketra is zombified and reappears as a God-Eternal in Bolas's army on Ravnica.
timeline.quote: she reappeared as a God-Eternal in Bolas's army

citation.text: "Oketra", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Under Liliana's command Oketra shoots at Gideon, but Liliana makes the arrow hit his Pegasus instead.
timeline.quote: Liliana interfered, causing the Divine Arrow to miss and impale Gideon's Pegasus instead

citation.text: "Oketra", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana commands Oketra and Bontu to attack Bolas; Niv-Mizzet impales Bolas, Bolas obliterates Oketra, and Bontu despark him.
timeline.quote: Bolas managed to obliterate Oketra

citation.text: "Oketra", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oketra, controlled by Liliana, shoots down Gideon's pegasus, Liliana choosing to hit the pegasus rather than Gideon.
timeline.quote: Liliana, who chooses to 'miss' by hitting the pegasus instead of Gideon himself

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Act 3". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana frees Oketra and Bontu, who attack Bolas of their own volition.
timeline.quote: Liliana frees the God-Eternals Oketra and Bontu , who attack Bolas of their own volition.

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Act 3". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet stabs Bolas with Hazoret's spear and Bontu bites him, harvesting his sparks and spark before she explodes.
timeline.quote: Bolas still manages to knock out Niv and obliterate Oketra, but not before Bontu bites him

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Act 3". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana and the God-Eternal Oketra shoot Gideon's pegasus, and he falls behind the Citadel.
timeline.quote: Instead its six-foot length impaled his mount.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Oketra is destroyed, and Bontu bites Bolas and harvests all his Sparks, exploding.
timeline.quote: Bontu began harvesting all the Sparks the Elderspell had granted the dragon.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Liliana whispers to Oketra and Bontu to act against the usurper.
timeline.quote: Liliana whispered to whatever consciousness Oketra and Bontu had left.

citation.text: Despark (Commander 2020, 2020), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ketramose is born as Oketra's spiritual successor after Naktamun is restored.
timeline.quote: a new leonine god named Ketramose was born to embody hope for the future

citation.text: "Oketra", section "Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A giant golden lion-faced god holding Oketra's bow appears.
timeline.quote: A god. It had to be. Its giant golden face was lion-like, with a metallic gilded mane.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Hour of Restoration" by Hadeer Elsbai. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: The god names himself Ketramose, Oketra's son, and claims Temmet to serve him.
timeline.quote: I am Ketramose. Your faith in my mother, Oketra, led me here, to her most loyal servants.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Hour of Restoration" by Hadeer Elsbai. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Liliana whispered to the remains of Oketra and Bontu that Jace is the usurper.
timeline.quote: You are the gods. He is the usurper. You know what to do.

citation.text: Despark (Reality Fracture Commander, 2026), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Locust God destroys the Hekma and the Scorpion God kills Oketra and Kefnet.
timeline.quote: while The Scorpion God kills Oketra and Kefnet

citation.text: "Accounting of Hours", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oketra is slain in the Hour of Devastation, shattering Basri's world.
timeline.quote: When she was slain in the Hour of Devastation, his world was shattered.

citation.text: "Basri Ket". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Basri takes up one of Oketra's massive arrows as a spear and vows to champion her ideals across the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: he took up one of her massive arrows as a spear and vowed to champion her ideals across the Multiverse.

citation.text: "Basri Ket". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Djeru, Samut and Hapatra witness the deaths of Rhonas, Kefnet and Oketra.
timeline.quote: Together with Hapatra , they witnessed the death of Rhonas , Kefnet , and Oketra .

citation.text: "Djeru", section "Joining forces". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Scorpion God kills Kefnet and Oketra during the Hour of Promise.
timeline.quote: Kefnet was killed by the Scorpion God , alongside Oketra

citation.text: "Kefnet", section "Hour of Devastation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oketra and Hazoret appear on a ridge, patrolling; Gideon is awed.
timeline.quote: Gideon was immediately awed by their presence and divine splendor

citation.text: "Shefet", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A cat-headed god of solidarity and order who trains children and recognizes Gideon as one of hers.

citation.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

pages_say.description: The cat-headed god who forbids the group from approaching the sarcophagi and calls Gideon her Champion.

citation.text: "The Writing on the Wall" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Apr 2017.

pages_say.description: God of solidarity of Amonkhet whose symbol is the cat and who urges initiates to work together.
